definitions.gloss: water surface, surface of the water
definitions.explanation: The top layer or surface of a body of water.

examples.japanese: {魚|さかな}が{水面|すいめん}に{浮|う}かんできた。
examples.english: A fish came up to the surface of the water.

examples.japanese: {風|かぜ}で{水面|すいめん}が{波立|なみだ}っている。
examples.english: The water surface is rippling in the wind.

examples.japanese: {水面|すいめん}に{月|つき}が{映|うつ}っていた。
examples.english: The moon was reflected on the water surface.

notes:
{水面|すいめん} refers to the surface of any body of water—lakes, rivers, oceans, pools, etc.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {水面|すいめん}に{浮|う}かぶ: to float on the water surface
- {水面|すいめん}に{映|うつ}る: to be reflected on the water
- {水面|すいめん}が{波立|なみだ}つ: the water surface ripples
- {水面下|すいめんか}: below the surface (literally and figuratively)

FIGURATIVE USE:
{水面下|すいめんか} (below the surface) is often used to describe hidden activities or negotiations happening behind the scenes.
